quote.translation: I buy a hectogram balance, weigh the part that the kilogram balance could not measure, and it comes to 3, so I write 3 to the right of the first 3.

There is clearly no necessary connection of any kind between the figure first obtained and the figure obtained now, for there can be no connection between, on one side, the cause that gave this pebble the weight it has at the instant I weigh it and, on the other, the reason that led the French legislators to fix the kilogram as the unit of weight and to divide it decimally.
